skills.name: RELIABLE CAPTAIN
skills.description: At the start of each round, for every {1} Nekoma player on your side, TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) gains {2} stack(s) of the [Connect] Buff, each stack increasing the power of his touches by {3}% of his corresponding stat, up to {4} stacks. Whenever TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) gains [Connect], one other player on your side also gains the same number of [Connect] stack(s).

skills.name: STEADY RECEIVE
skills.description: TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) performs a Receive with power equal to {1}% of his Receive stat. While TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) is on the court, when your side performs a PERFECT Receive or Save, your players’ Set stat increases by {2} points, lasting for {3} round(s).

skills.name: LEADERSHIP
skills.description: Whenever a player on your side with a Receive skill touches the ball, each stack of [Connect] increases their ATK Technique and DEF Technique by {1}% for {2} net crossings.\nWhen [Connect] stacks are at least {3}, TETSURO KUROO (School Banner)'s defensive touches are guaranteed to be Critical, and his Spirit increases by {4}%.\nWhen [Connect] stacks are at least {5}, if your side performs a PERFECT Save, your players' ATK Technique and DEF Technique increase by {6}% for {7} round(s). TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) additionally gains the skill: TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) performs a Save with power equal to {8}% of his Save stat (Cooldown: {9} net crossings)

skills.name: SKILLFUL BLOCK
skills.description: TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) performs a Block with power equal to {1}% of his Block stat. If the Block result is not PERFECT, the cooldown of SKILLFUL BLOCK is reset, and the power of his next Block increases by {2}% of his Block stat.

While TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) is on the court, whenever your side triggers a result-modifying skill, TETSURO KUROO (School Banner)'s Strength and Spirit increase by {0}%, up to {1}%. At the start of each round, if there are at least {2} Nekoma players on your side, TETSURO KUROO (School Banner) gains {3} stack(s) of [Connect], up to {4} stacks.

Your players' Strength and Spirit increase by {0}% of TETSURO KUROO (School Banner)'s corresponding stats, up to {1}%. When [Connect] stacks are at least {2}, TETSURO KUROO (School Banner)'s offensive touches are guaranteed to be Critical, and his Strength increases by {3}%.

bonds.name: School Banner
bonds.description: When the number of [Connect] stacks is greater than [Fly] stacks, DAICHI SAWAMURA (School Banner)'s [Fly] stacks becomes {0}; when the number of [Fly] stacks is greater than [Connect] stacks, TETSURO KUROO (School Banner)'s [Connect] stacks becomes {1}.
